assets.creator: The project maintainer, working in SVG with AI drafting assistance (Claude).
edits: Replaced the prototype, which set the ✊ Unicode character in an SVG text element and therefore rendered whichever emoji glyph the viewer's operating system supplied, or none. That glyph was third-party artwork the project could not license.

Redrew the raised fist as original geometry — a rounded field, fist mass, four knuckles, thumb and forearm — using only the project's own semantic palette. No font is involved, so the icon renders identically everywhere.

The initial geometry was drafted with AI assistance. Every shipped value and every compositional decision is the maintainer's: the knuckle heights and corner radii, the thumb's prominence, optical horizontal centring to counter the thumb's one-sided protrusion, a terminating forearm so the cream shape carries field above and below, and the removal of the cuff notch in favour of one continuous cream silhouette — made against the drafting advice, and correctly.

Reviewed and accepted at 128, 64, 32 and 16 pixels. Measured rather than eyeballed: the painted artwork sits 11.50 from the left, 11.50 from the right, 13.50 from the top and 12.50 from the bottom of the 64-unit field.
assets.replacementStatus: Production-approved on 16 August 2026 on the maintainer's perceptual acceptance at 128, 64, 32 and 16 pixels. Original project geometry using the project palette, with no third-party or font-supplied artwork. Recorded as human-created because the shipped composition is the maintainer's throughout; the AI drafting assistance behind the first draft is disclosed above rather than omitted. The geometry is seven primitive rectangles and remains trivially editable by hand.

assets.creator: Derived mechanically from raised-fist-favicon; see that entry for authorship.
edits: Rendered from favicon.svg by scripts/generate-icons.mjs using the repository's own Chromium, so the application icons cannot drift from the authored favicon. Re-run the script after editing favicon.svg.
The maskable variant is drawn at 90 per cent on a full-bleed field of the same colour, so its rounded corners merge into the backdrop and Android's own mask cannot clip the artwork.
assets.replacementStatus: Production-approved on 16 August 2026, deriving from the accepted favicon. Regenerating them requires no separate approval because they are a mechanical derivation rather than independent artwork.
